evidence: Extensively updates wallet transaction creation, coin selection (`src/wallet/spend.cpp`), fee bumping (`src/wallet/feebumper.cpp`), and wallet database schemas (`src/wallet/walletdb.cpp`) to support BIP 352 Silent Payments.
rationale: Implements wallet sending support for BIP 352 Silent Payments, delivering a major privacy feature requested by users. It adds dynamic taproot scriptPubKey derivation from selected private keys, safeguards against unfindable outputs by enforcing eligible coin selection, and persists destination metadata to allow RBF fee-bumps.
